context_for_next_testing_agent: Master Telegram notification feature fully tested and working. All 3 new endpoints (PATCH /telegram, POST /test-telegram, POST /reset-notifications) verified. Frontend MasterTelegramSettings.js component renders correctly with all UI elements (instructions, toggle, inputs, buttons). Access control properly enforced - masters can only modify their own settings. Test-telegram endpoint correctly returns Telegram API errors for invalid tokens. Note: Console shows 403 errors for /api/admin/stats/masters when logged in as master - this is expected behavior as masters don't have admin access.
